specialist_trace.rationale: To ensure accurate coding, the provider must explicitly document the diagnostic criteria used for GDM (e.g., IADPSG/WHO thresholds) and confirm that the 2-hour value of 7.8 mmol/L meets the specific cutoff for diagnosis, as this is borderline. Additionally, specify the clinical type of GDM (e.g., diet-controlled vs. insulin-requiring) and state the clinical correlation of the abnormal OGTT with the patient’s asymptomatic status, clarifying that the diagnosis is based on lab criteria alone. This specificity is essential to distinguish GDM from other glucose abnormalities and to reflect the management plan accurately.
